integrity: All theorem, proof, verification, review, and code are included; self-review only, without independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Theorem concerns canonical real Euclidean-orthogonal cut/cycle projections for one-edge-deleted unweighted bicliques, with induced edge ell_1/ell_infinity norms; no minimum over arbitrary projections, weighted graphs, or larger matchings is claimed. Finite checks are not substitutes for the all-parameter proof.
title: Exact two-to-one endpoint Hodge-norm response to one missing biclique edge
